verdict.rationale: Loops documents event-triggered workflows for onboarding, activation, trial, upgrade, and winback/re-engagement email. Its workflow graphs support adding, branching, editing, and deleting nodes, so the core of multi-step lifecycle automation with branches is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of delay/wait steps, exit rules or goal-based exits, any description of the marketer-facing visual workflow builder, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
